answer: Influence must decay unless renewed by real work each epoch. Each identity files its own renewal receipt signed by its quill key, checked by peers against a glacier archive holding 12 epochs of receipts, so one operator cannot reuse one proof across keys. The fee follows the funding vine: a key posts a 100 POA deposit in escrow times the size of its cluster, so ten clones sharing one root pay 1000 each. Missed renewal will slash the bond, burn the holdback collateral and drop weight to zero.
